12.t: Jim McGorman Another major initiative for the Shire this financial year has been the management of the Mount Magnet rubbish tip The incidence of fires and illegal dumping at the tip has been reduced to near zero due to the implementation of the rubbish tip being a manned site The separation of refuse has enabled the shire to meet their environmental commitments, providing opportunity for management of recycling and controlling the disposal of materials into appropriate waste areas
